$comment: The FocuSD Island plugin protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, one message per line. A permission marked sensitive is confirmed by the user on the island the first time it is used (refused: -32001). This file is the source of truth; src-tauri/src/plugin_host/tests.rs checks the host against it and docs/plugins/README.md describes it for people. 'since' is the plugin API version (manifest apiVersion) that introduced the item; 'capability' names the entry in initialize.capabilities that says the host has it.

capabilities.name: views
capabilities.meaning: contributes.views drawn on the island; view.update / view.patch and the view.action / view.submit / view.search / view.visible notifications.

capabilities.name: status
capabilities.meaning: contributes.statusItems on the collapsed bar; status.update.

events.name: todos.changed
events.payload: { date }; call todos.list for the todos

events.name: note.changed
events.payload: { date }; call note.get for the text

events.name: clipboard.changed
events.payload: {}; call clipboard.history. Only while clipboard history is on.

events.name: messages.received
events.payload: One entry as in messages.list: { source, id, sender, preview, receivedAt, unread? }

events.name: media.changed
events.payload: Same as media.nowPlaying; sent when the track, player or play state changes (checked every 2 s while subscribed), not for the position.

methods.name: host.info
methods.result: Same as the initialize params.

methods.name: settings.get
methods.result: Every declared setting with its current value (defaults filled in).

params.items: [{ label: LocalizedText, value: string (max 500 chars), copy?: boolean, secret?: boolean }] (max 10; empty clears)

methods.name: events.subscribe

params.events: [string] (max 16; each needs the event's permission; all are checked before any is applied)

methods.result: { events }: every event the plugin is subscribed to, sorted

methods.name: events.unsubscribe
methods.result: { events }

methods.name: view.update

params.model: object for the view's template (see docs/plugins/README.md); max 256 KB as JSON, else status 413

methods.result: {}. The island shows at most 10 changes a second per view (later ones are merged) and only while the page is on screen.

methods.name: view.patch

params.items: [{ id, ... }]: replace the items with these ids in model.items and model.groups[].items

methods.result: { missing: [id] }: ids not found. Status 409 before the first view.update.

params.text: string, max 24 characters; empty clears the item

methods.name: storage.get
methods.result: { value }: null when the key is not set

params.value: any JSON (max 64 KB as JSON; the plugin's whole storage max 1 MB, else status 413)

methods.name: storage.delete
methods.result: { deleted }

methods.name: storage.keys
methods.result: { keys }

methods.name: host.keepAlive

params.reason: string (1-100 chars) shown on the plugin page; null lets the plugin stop when idle again

methods.result: {}. Only matters for on-demand plugins (activationEvents), which otherwise stop after 60 s with nothing to do.

methods.name: todos.list
methods.result: { date, todos, scheduled, activeTodoId }

methods.name: todos.add

params.title: string
params.date?: YYYY-MM-DD; later than today goes to the 'later' list

methods.result: The new todo.

methods.name: todos.update
methods.result: The changed todo.

methods.name: todos.remove
methods.result: { id }

methods.name: note.get
methods.result: { date, note }

methods.name: note.set
methods.result: { date, note }

methods.name: agentStatus.report
methods.result: The saved status; id is '<plugin id>/<source>'.

methods.name: agentStatus.clear

params.source?: string; omitted clears every source of the plugin

methods.result: { cleared }

methods.name: island.notify
methods.result: { muted }: true when the user turned this plugin's messages off (nothing is shown). At most 6 per minute per plugin, else -32000 with status 429.

methods.name: secrets.get
methods.result: { value }: null when not set

params.value: string (max 1024 chars); at most 32 secrets per plugin (status 413)

methods.name: secrets.delete
methods.result: { deleted }

methods.name: clipboard.history
methods.result: { items: [{ id, text (max 4000 chars), truncated, copiedAt, favorite }] }: text items only, newest first. Status 409 while clipboard history is off.

methods.name: messages.list
methods.result: { items: [{ source: qq | wechat | qqMail, id, sender, preview, receivedAt, unread? }] }, newest first, from the sources the user switched on. WeChat entries have sender and preview null (only the tray flash is known); qqMail preview is the subject, never the body.

methods.name: media.nowPlaying
methods.result: { available, status, title, artist, album, sourceApp, positionMs, durationMs } (no cover image)

methods.name: media.playPause
methods.result: Same as media.nowPlaying, after the command.

methods.name: media.next
methods.result: Same as media.nowPlaying, after the command.

methods.name: media.previous
methods.result: Same as media.nowPlaying, after the command.

methods.name: shelf.list
methods.result: { items: [{ id, path, name, isDir, size, addedAt, pinned, missing, unreachable }] }: paths only, never file contents.

methods.name: shelf.add

params.paths: [string] (1-20 absolute paths of existing files or folders; others are skipped)

methods.result: Same as shelf.list, afterwards.

methods.name: shelf.remove

params.ids: [string] (1-20); only takes entries off the shelf, never deletes files

methods.result: Same as shelf.list, afterwards.

toPlugin.name: initialize
toPlugin.params: { apiVersion, capabilities (since 2), activationEvent (since 2: onStartup, onCommand:<id>, onView:<id>, onEvent:<name>, onSchedule:<minutes> or onStartupFinished), appVersion, pluginId, dataDir, permissions, settings }

toPlugin.name: command
toPlugin.params: { id, args? }: a button on the plugin page or the command's keybinding (since 2) sends { id }; an entry of the todo right-click menu (contributes.menus "todo/context", since 2) sends { id, args: { todoId } }

toPlugin.name: event
toPlugin.params: { name, payload }; at most one per event name every 200 ms, carrying the latest payload. Subscriptions end when the process exits.

toPlugin.name: notification.action
toPlugin.params: { id }: the user clicked that button of an island.notify message

toPlugin.name: view.visible
toPlugin.params: { viewId, visible }: the page was opened or closed; send updates while it is visible

toPlugin.name: view.action
toPlugin.params: { viewId, actionId, itemId?, checked? }: the user clicked an action or an item, or a check box (checked)

toPlugin.name: view.submit
toPlugin.params: { viewId, values }: the user submitted the form

toPlugin.name: view.search
toPlugin.params: { viewId, query }: the user typed in the list's search box (only if the model asks for searchMode remote)

errors.meaning: The plugin was not given the permission the method needs.

The island answered with an error; data.status is 400 bad params, 404 not found, 413 too large, 409 the feature is switched off, 429 too many requests, 500 the host could not do it (e.g. a file or the Credential Manager failed), 504 no answer in time.
